title.zh: 共同问题与可修订目的

scope.zh: 集体对齐会话的提醒；同时作为相关研究选题时的方法约束。
scope.en: The collective-alignment session’s reminder, also a methodological constraint when relevant studies choose their questions.

objective.zh: 研究共同活动如何辨明、解决问题，并修订问题、目的和组织。
objective.en: Investigate how shared activity identifies and addresses problems while revising problem statements, ends and organization.

premises.zh: 不默认对立利益、筹码、谁赢更多或固定共同效用；保留实际冲突。
premises.en: Do not presume opposed interests, bargaining leverage, who wins more or fixed shared utility; retain actual conflicts.

completion.zh: 复用已完成机制，明确新的共同问题形成与回应连接。
completion.en: Reuse completed mechanisms and identify the new connection in forming and responding to common problems.
